project_title: Paperback Cover: Blurb Edit & Font Consistency Fix

project_metadata.job_title: Paperback Cover: Blurb Edit & Font Consistency Fix
project_metadata.job_description: Paperback Cover: Blurb Edit & Font Consistency Fix

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]
I have a small, quick task and wanted to check whether you’re available.

• My paperback cover requires 2 minor fixes: removing a few words from my blurb and making the title font consistent across the front/spine/back. This is not a redesign; the files are otherwise final.
• Required outputs: .psd (layered), .pdf, .jpg
• Turnaround needed within 24 hours
• Can you take this on?

My budget is $30.

[FREELANCER_NAME_003],
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes, okay.

I am available.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: [CLIENT_NAME_001], let's proceed with the project.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Here is a paperback book cover that I completed recently.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], thank you for replying so quickly.

Two minor corrections are required, not a redesign.
Blurb replacement: I trimmed the last paragraph, which currently overlaps the barcode, so the new text only needs to be inserted and reflowed.
Title font mismatch: the front cover has a bold gold-gradient font, while the spine/back use a simpler one; they all need to match the front.
I'll provide the images, templates, and the .psd.
I need the .psd (layered), .pdf, and .jpg returned within 24 hours — is that workable?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, it works [CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Great. I'll invite you to the job and upload the details. Thx! [FREELANCER_NAME_003], [CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay, [CLIENT_NAME_001], thank you for giving me this opportunity.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I will be waiting to receive the editable files.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
I'm attaching book 1 (The Emperor's Curse) so you can compare its fonts with those currently used on book 2's spine and back cover. I want the fonts to be consistent. Please tell me if you have any questions.
[FREELANCER_NAME_003],
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The.psd failed to go through. I'll upload it now.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay, I will review them now.

If I have any questions, I will let you know.

Just to confirm, your book has 300 pages, right?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yes, it has 300 pages. FYI - I publish through Amazon, where the print book is 300 pages. However, Draft2Digital uses Ingram for print distribution, and they added 2 pages to the book. I’m unsure whether that changes the spine. That is why I’m shortening my blurb, since I can’t prevent D2D from changing the page count to 302 instead of 300. The problem is the bar code.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: As you can see, D2D's template specifies a 0.68-inch spine, whereas Amazon's specifies 0.75 inches.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay, I understand how both Amazon and Ingramspark work.

Because Ingram adds 2 pages, we can prepare versions for both 300 and 302 pages.

And yes, the specifications may differ between the two platforms.

To be safe, we'll need a version for each platform. That would be the better approach.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Excellent idea.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Alright, [CLIENT_NAME_001].

I will send you an update in some hours.

I had been about to step away from my work desk when your message arrived.

I now understand the project clearly.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Excellent, thanks. Are we still agreed on the price?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Ohhh

We haven't discussed that yet.

Since we'll now be working on both Amazon and Ingramspark, you can add $20 for the Ingramspark version.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: [CLIENT_NAME_001], please let me know what you think about that.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Of course. I’m currently asking D2D whether this is a bug. For 300–302 pages printed on Cream paper, the spine should be about 0.75", which exactly matches my Amazon file, yet D2D continues to generate 0.68". This still happens after I followed their directions to resave Step 2 and download a fresh template again. I definitely want you to correct the blurb and font, so please begin with those. I’ll update you soon about the spine.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay.

We can begin with the Amazon version.

That one is ready to proceed.

I have never encountered Ingram adding 2 pages before.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Its rather a shock. :)

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For now, let's use 300 pages and a 0.75" spine. I need a response from D2D before making any spine changes. Thanks!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Here is a screenshot.

I have completed the changes.

The title font on the spine and back now matches the title font on the front.

The spine width has also been applied, and the overall cover complies with Amazon requirements.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: What is the status of the second one? Once I know, I can deliver all the files.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I will verify this on my side.

D2D may possibly use requirements that differ from Amazon's.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: It looks good. Can it be downloaded and tested on D2D's platform?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I’m still waiting and haven’t received any news from D2D. It’s extremely frustrating.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes, certainly.

I will send the PDF file for you to test.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: thanks

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Here it is.

The file size is 223MB.

I will wait to hear the D2D test results.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I’ll try posting on D2D's social media; perhaps that will prompt a quicker reply.

However, I found an issue with your cover.

• The blurb correction and title font both look good and were fixed properly.
• There is one issue: the tagline at the top of the front cover ("A CHINESE HOLIDAY MURDER MYSTERY") appears as garbled, corrupted text rather than the actual wording.
• It seems likely to be a font-substitution or encoding problem, so please verify which font that text box uses.
• During the new export, please ensure the fonts are embedded or outlined/converted to curves so the text renders correctly everywhere without relying on font availability.
• Please correct this and re-send the .pdf first.

Thx
C-

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay 

I will check now

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
It has now been corrected.

I apologize for the earlier mistake.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Got it. Today is launch day, so I need to handle social media. I’ll follow up later today. Thkx. Hopefully I’ll have heard from D2D by then.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Alright, that's great.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I can’t believe D2D still hasn’t responded. Let’s pause this until tomorrow. I’ll place an order for something, although its cover specifications may or may not be correct. I’ll allow them one more day. Thank you for being patient. [FREELANCER_NAME_003], [CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay, [CLIENT_NAME_001].

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_002], it still doesn’t appear to be fixed. Please redo it and verify it yourself.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I will try again

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Ohh, perhaps I accidentally sent the previous file.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I’ll send the correct file to you.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Ok. An old/cached file may have been sent accidentally; I’m retesting now.
\- D2D update: I still need 2 covers (Amazon + Ingram), but the 0.68" spine from D2D conflicts with Ingram's own formula, which indicates 0.755". This remains unresolved and could take 48-72 hrs.
\- Please don’t build anything using 0.68" until I verify the correct measurement.
\- I’ll follow up shortly.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay.

Just to clarify, are you using Amazon, Ingramspark, and D2D? Three platforms, right?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Your book is going to be available on the three platforms, correct?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: No, only AMazon and D2D. For print, D2D uses Ingram's network.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_002] — a quick update: I don’t have an Ingram account, so I can’t verify this personally. I’ve therefore asked D2D which paper-thickness factor they use, because Ingram's cream stock may genuinely be thinner than Amazon's, which would account for the spine discrepancy. (Unfortunately - replies from D2D are slow). I’ll also ask in some author FB groups in case anyone there knows. This is very frustrating. Can we leave this job open for another day or two? Thanks! On the positive side, I now know that I need 2 covers made. I didn’t encounter this issue with book 1 :). Meanwhile, could you confirm the page count, font, etc. that you used for the revised cover? Thx

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: No problem, [CLIENT_NAME_001].

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I'll resend the Amazon cover shortly, and then that part will be finished.

It will still remain D2D only.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: This screenshot shows what I see on my end after downloading the most recently sent file.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I just attempted to upload your latest file to Amazon. I don't know what the error is because no reason is provided—only that message.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: My AI gives this explanation: Font embedding. We already discovered an issue in this project where a font had not been embedded or outlined correctly, which caused garbled text in another viewer. The fonts in this file may not be fully embedded, and KDP's processor could be more strict about this than the tool I used for the preview.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Here are the PDF font details; they indicate that every font is embedded.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Well hmmm. I'm stuck then.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: It appears that the file is too large for Amazon to process. I'll send you a newly exported pdf file.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Ok. Amazon does permit 650 MB, but a bloated file can sometimes be more likely to time out or fail during the transfer. Go ahead and send the smaller file. thx.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I've reduced the PDF file size to make the upload smoother. The print quality remains unchanged.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I finally managed to upload the bigger file. I'll keep the smaller file available as a back up.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay.

That's good.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: That means D2D is the only thing remaining.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: yep

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
HI [FREELANCER_NAME_001],
Please proceed with the D2D cover using the 0.68 inches spine width from the D2D template. I'll update the job to add $20. I still haven't heard from D2D. However, I can't believe their template has a bug; otherwise, many authors would be complaining. Thanks,
[FREELANCER_NAME_003],
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Here's the D2D template.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Optimized version

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Please upload this to D2D and let me know your feedback.

Both files are identical.

One of them has a lower file size.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks will test it now

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Could you provide the final product in PDF, .PSD and .JPG?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Could you resend the PDFs? Apologies. I can no longer tell which one is for amazon (300 pages) and which one is for D2D (302 pages). thkx

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Yes, of course.

Should I include the PDFs with the deliveries again?

I have already sent them.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: yes please

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I'm ready to close the contract. There is another issue with D2D. They include Amazon on their print set up page. I can't determine whether they'll distribute to Amazon, which would duplicate my listing and double my commission, as well as get me in trouble with Amazon. Anyhow, I'll need to wait for their response, so I still can't hit publish on D2D. But that is my issue, not yours. Please send the files over.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Okay, no problem.

I am preparing the files to send as a ZIP.

You can approve the first $30 now that the Amazon one is sorted.

After that, only D2D will remain.
